englishSourceNotes: 'color in the lines' has no short bokmål equivalent: 'fargelegge innenfor strekene' pushes the sentence to 36 chars (over the hard max). Used 'Jeg kan fargelegge pent' (colour neatly), the way Norwegian teachers phrase the same skill; still a real yes/no.
'catch a fish' rendered as 'fiske med stang' (fish with a rod): matches the fishing_rod cue exactly; Norwegian children do not say 'fange en fisk' (they say 'få fisk').
'go on a hike' = 'gå på tur', the core Norwegian barnehage activity; exact match for the hiker-with-poles picture.
'drum a beat' = 'tromme i takt' (drum in time), the phrase used in barnehage music sessions.
'help bake a cake' = 'være med og bake kake', the natural Norwegian way to say a child helps; also fits the adult-chef baking picture.
'bug' heading uses 'kryp' (creepy-crawly), which covers insects, snail, spider and worm; 'insekt' avoided as instructed.
'treat' = 'godsak' (a goodie): covers cake, waffle, lollipop and popsicle; 'godteri' would exclude cake/waffle and 'dessert' would exclude the lollipop.
'clothes' kept plural like EN ('Favorittklærne mine'); 'Favorittplagget mitt' (singular garment) is the alternative if a singular is preferred.
'button my coat' = 'kneppe jakka mi': a 5-year-old calls this coat a 'jakke', not a 'frakk' (see flag).

otherNotes: Four headings exceed the 22-char target but should fit two lines with no word over 20 chars: 'Favorittkjæledyret mitt' (23), 'Favorittinstrumentet mitt' (25; its first word is exactly 20), 'Favorittkjøretøyet mitt' (23), 'Favorittdyret på gården' (23). Norwegian compounds make the shipped pattern (Favoritt + definite noun + possessive) long; please test the box.

Gender follows the shipped pattern: masculine/feminine take 'min' (frukten, grønnsaken, hobbyen, godsaken, fuglen, frokosten, formen), neuter take 'mitt' (kjæledyret, instrumentet, krypet, kjøretøyet), plural 'mine' (klærne). 'sea' and 'farm' use a place phrase, which is the natural Norwegian wording.
'kjøretøy' is used in Norwegian picture books for fly, båt and rakett as well, so it covers the whole vehicle row.
All 27 sentences are first person 'Jeg kan …' like the shipped entries, ≤ 30 chars (longest 'Jeg kan være med og bake kake' = 29), no digits, no braces.

Verb spread: self sheet pusse/gre/vaske/kle/kneppe/ta på/re opp/feie (no repeats); school skrive/lese/legge/male/klippe/bruke/fargelegge/pakke; play synge/tromme/spille x2/bygge/være med/ta/sende opp (spille twice, as in EN); outdoors gå på x2 (shipped)/fiske/sove/vanne/hoppe/huske/slå opp.
